Specification: This module defines TLC-checkable tests for graph reachability properties used by the correctness proof of module ReachabilityProofs. It ranges over successor functions from Nodes to SUBSET Nodes and checks the imported properties Reachable0 through Reachable3 for each chosen successor function, using both exhaustive and randomized sets of successor functions.
IfThenElse: IF D = {} THEN F ELSE LET d == CHOOSE d \in D : TRUE S == RandomElement(SUBSET Nodes) IN RS(F @@ (d :> S), D \ {d})
